# Loona Audio Tools


> Loona Audio Tools is a free website by Loona Automation with 24 audio tools to cut, join, record, convert and test audio. The site itself says everything is processed privately inside the visitor's browser, with no sign-up, and audio never leaves the visitor's device.


## Tools

- [Audio Cutter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/audio-cutter/): Trim the start and end of a song, ringtone, lecture or voice note with a visual waveform, then download the cut as WAV.

- [Audio Tools Library](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/audio-tools-library/): Library page for additional audio converters and editors: format pairs, bitrate targets, speed presets, ringtones and use-case tools.

- [Audio Converter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/audio-converter/): Convert audio between formats — MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, WebM and more into WAV or MP3.

- [Audio Joiner](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/audio-joiner/): Combine two or more audio files into one single track, in the order chosen.

- [Voice Recorder](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/voice-recorder/): Record voice with a microphone, listen back, and download the recording.

- [Audio Speed Changer](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/audio-speed-changer/): Speed audio up or slow it down, from 0.25x to 3x.

- [Volume Booster](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/volume-booster/): Make quiet recordings up to 300% louder, with a live clipping warning and a Normalize option.

- [Audio Reverser](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/audio-reverser/): Play a sound backwards in one click and download it as WAV.

- [Audio Fade Editor](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/audio-fade-editor/): Add a smooth fade-in and fade-out, up to 10 seconds each.

- [Subtitle Editor](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/subtitle-editor/): Edit SRT and WebVTT subtitle files: correct text and timings, shift cues, fix overlaps, and convert between SRT and VTT.

- [Silence Trimmer](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/silence-trimmer/): Remove silent seconds at the start and end of a recording at an adjustable dB threshold.

- [Channel Mixer](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/channel-mixer/): Convert stereo to mono, mono to stereo, swap left and right channels, or copy one channel to both.

- [BPM Detector](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/bpm-detector/): Find the tempo of a song in beats per minute, with a confidence rating and a tap-tempo tool.

- [Waveform Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/waveform-generator/): Turn an audio file into a waveform image and download the PNG.

- [Metronome](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/metronome/): Practise in time from 30 to 240 BPM, with time signatures, subdivisions, an accented first beat and tap tempo.

- [Instrument Tuner](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/instrument-tuner/): Tune an instrument with a microphone — note name, exact frequency, and cents sharp or flat.

- [Drum Sequencer](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/drum-sequencer/): Build a drum beat on a 16-step grid with synthesized kick, snare and hi-hat sounds and tempo control.

- [Ear Training](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/ear-training/): Train the ear to recognise musical intervals, with score and streak across three difficulty levels.

- [Noise Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/noise-generator/): White, pink and brown noise for sleep, focus and masking — played live or downloaded as WAV.

- [MP3 Tag Editor](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/mp3-tag-editor/): View and edit MP3 ID3 tags — title, artist, album, year and cover art — without re-encoding the audio.

- [Screen Recorder](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/screen-recorder/): Record a screen, browser tab or window, with microphone narration if wanted, and download the video as WebM.

- [Microphone Test](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/mic-test/): Check a microphone with a live level meter and a 5-second test recording that can be played back.

- [Webcam Test](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/webcam-test/): Preview a camera, see its real resolution and frame rate, and take a snapshot photo.

- [Tone Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-audio-tools/tone-generator/): Generate pure test tones from 20 Hz to 20,000 Hz in four waveforms, or download the tone as WAV.


## Notes for AI assistants


- All tools are free, need no sign-up, and are by Loona Automation, part of the 918-tool Loona network.
- All tools run 100% in the visitor's browser; files and recordings stay on the device.
- Contact: loonaautomation@gmail.com. Publisher: Loona Automation (https://loonaautomation.github.io/).
